label: One relay cut preserves bottom activity exactly at or above a maintained feed
paraphrase: Fix receiver zero and one power on a natural-number successor roster. The all-active intact profile and a family of single-cut responses exist for both the relay-only model and each model with its sole separate active feed at depth d. Cutting the link i+1 into i extinguishes receiver zero in every relay-only response. With a maintained separate active feed at depth d, receiver zero stays active in every admissible response exactly when d ≤ i. Thus d is the least cut position preserving the receiver's activity, including d = 0. For any bound k, depth k+1 reproduces failure at every i ≤ k and preserves activity at the next cut.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Fix the candidate roster and q3a4 profile. Keep the readout at relay zero and take the incoming supplier list under test to be the list of the recipient at depth d. Calibrate the activity readout to the identified bearer being in act as to esse. Separately calibrate the already identified links, including the known path from d to zero, to actual distinct-bearer causes in the same esse respect and warrant their transmission law. If a fresh readout survives a cut the relay-only account predicts will extinguish it, use the single-feed threshold to locate d. Isolate a candidate extra channel at that recipient. Independent evidence would have to identify its bearer c as distinct from the bearer at d and show that c directly supplies esse to that bearer, rather than having only an upstream or downstream effect. Establish the act and CausesIn conditions for this candidate independently of the calibration of known links. Then a verified direct supplier absent from the list at d would challenge the list completeness used by the finite root audit.
connection_plan.blocker: The checked relay experiment observes fresh token delivery by bearers that persist through the cuts. Calibration to the bearer being in act as to esse and to ActualEsseCause is missing. The threshold locates a feed position in the specified model, while an active position supplies neither a distinct bearer nor a direct edge to the recipient. A feed entering at d can change the readout at zero even if zero's direct list is complete. Survival gives neither an empty list nor roster-wide audit coverage, and failure at finitely many cuts leaves deeper feeds open.
